description: Rustic photo stands: fuzzy-skin (Perlin) texture on the outside only, for a stone / weathered look. The Rustic models have closed-end slots, so contour-only fuzzy skin leaves the slot smooth at the plain width. Looks best in wood-fill or marble PLA.
changelog: 2026-10-13  created from photo_stands: fuzzy skin on outer walls, Perlin noise (organic stone texture rather than classic static)
2026-10-13  note: fuzzy skin also roughens the slot walls, hence the 1.8 mm Rustic slot and 1.6-2.4 mm Rustic comb

2026-10-14  Rustic models now have closed-end slots: an enclosed hole in every layer, so fuzzy_skin=external (contour) skips it; slot back to the plain 1.4 mm (user: fuzzy everywhere but the blank cutout)
